title: sentinel file removal error silently ignored in new()
description: new() writes and then removes .write_test sentinel files (lines 82, 94). The removal failure is silently discarded with 'let _ = ...' — no log, no return value. If removal fails (permission race, full filesystem during cleanup), the sentinel file persists in the queue and dead/ dirs permanently. A future drain scan won't misidentify it (no .env extension), but it will confuse operators doing manual inspection. Should at least warn! on removal failure.
